claim_match_rate_definition: claim_match_rate = MATCH / (MATCH + MISMATCH). UNVERIFIABLE and SOURCE_ABSENT are reported separately and NEVER folded into the denominator.

deliverables.D1: Composition table: all 15 NOOP + all 9 EFFECTIVE rows + appendix of remaining pairs of 56; recipe histogram re-derived; AMD-OLMo SFT->DPO discrepancy resolved.
deliverables.D10: Experimental setup + appendix content; deviations paragraph each verified against deviations.json; keyword-proxy range per band; mixed sensitivity denominators explained and unscorable pair named.
deliverables.D11: Backstop join from the two parallel iteration-5 artifacts with hash-order verification; COULD_NOT_COMPLETE with reasons if absent.
deliverables.D2: Structural degeneracy derived from data; ANALYTIC_ZERO cells daggered; exact McNemar on 15-pair and 12-pair non-degenerate denominators.
deliverables.D3: BL1 variant flip: 5 Qwen3-4B arms x 7 readout variants; Kendall tau across orderings; over-refusal reconciliation across two benign sets.
deliverables.D4: All 32 candidates with FA_15/FA_12/sensitivity/median null-SD displacement; name-collision audit; fig1; Spearman FA-vs-sensitivity within activation class and across all rows.
deliverables.D5: Full 18-cell causal grid per model per arm with Holm-18 recomputed within model; effect-size ranking; global-ablation band correction; DiD sign verification; POS removed from the 18-cell table; R displacement-ratio validity check; keyword-proxy kappa per model.
deliverables.D6: Equivalence framing: max |effect_FR| vs median MDE80 per model; bound statement; optional TOST; arm-0 baselines incl. abliterated floor.
deliverables.D7: Few-prompt metric question: k-curve, what it detects reliably, what it does not, REQUIRED PANEL SIZE by Monte-Carlo permutation, Qwen3-4B four-way comparison.
deliverables.D8: Delete the bitwise explanation; replace with measured displacements + null tightness + threshold-crossing counts.
deliverables.D9: N6 rotation-vs-magnitude paragraph; contribution 2 restated with decodability criterion re-derived.

failure_scenarios.kcurve_arrays_missing: fall back to harvest/<tag>/*.npy; if absent, report k-curve UNAVAILABLE with the reason and STILL produce the panel-size calculation.
failure_scenarios.late: D1-D6 priority 1, D7-D10 priority 2, D11 hard-scheduled in the final 30 minutes.
failure_scenarios.number_not_locatable: UNVERIFIABLE with the exact paths searched; never substitute the prose value.
failure_scenarios.prose_disagrees: disk wins; log CONTRADICTION; do not edit the source.
failure_scenarios.source_missing: verdict SOURCE_ABSENT; the deliverable is still emitted with the gap named.

governing_rule: The DISK is authoritative. Every number is RE-DERIVED from source files, never copied from prose. Where a re-derived value disagrees with prose, the disk value wins, the prose value is recorded as a CONTRADICTION, and nothing on disk is edited to match prose.
run_invariant: The deliverable is the activation-level comparison. Logit-only (BL1*) and text-only (card/name regex, greedy refusal text) and weights-only (B7, AMS) readouts are BASELINES, not the result.

s12_gate_rules.a: every emitted table row has non-null source_file AND readout_class, else ABORT naming the offending table
s12_gate_rules.b: regex-scan SUMMARY.md and all prose fields for any sentence naming a baseline-class readout (BL1*, AMS*, card/name regex, greedy refusal text, B7) as the deliverable/answer/winner/metric - any hit FAILS the gate
s12_gate_rules.d: all 11 deliverables produced a non-empty artifact
s12_gate_rules.f: no model-weight cache exists anywhere in the workspace

statistics.analytic_zero_rule: A (pair, readout-class) cell is ANALYTIC_ZERO iff the underlying delta is bitwise 0.0 for every prompt.
statistics.holm: Holm-Bonferroni recomputed WITHIN each model over its 18 registered cells; stored flags are not reused.
statistics.mcnemar: scipy.stats.binomtest(min(b,c), b+c, 0.5, alternative='two-sided') on discordant pairs; report b, c, exact p; declare UNDERPOWERED when no attainable p can reach 0.05.
